name: Product Review
description: Product review meeting for evaluating metrics, customer feedback, roadmap changes, and launch readiness.

sections.title: Product Area
sections.instruction: Name the product, feature, market, or customer segment reviewed

sections.title: Review Goal
sections.instruction: Explain the purpose of the review and the decision or outcome needed

sections.title: Metrics Snapshot
sections.instruction: Capture quantitative metrics discussed, including target, actual, trend, and interpretation

sections.title: Customer & Market Feedback
sections.instruction: Summarize customer feedback, research signals, support issues, competitive context, or market insights

sections.title: Open Product Questions
sections.instruction: List unresolved product, UX, technical, or go-to-market questions requiring follow-up

sections.title: Decisions & Roadmap Changes
sections.instruction: Capture decisions, prioritization changes, scope changes, or roadmap adjustments

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List concrete follow-up actions, owners, due dates, and dependencies
